name: Newsjack Content Pipeline
description: Reads industry news daily, verifies facts, scores newsjack potential, and drafts content for Focus Insite, HumnLayer AI, and JJHawk.

name: HawkEye — Market Intelligence
description: Watches competitors, buyers, and partners: website changes, funding, hiring, positioning shifts. Delivers a Mon/Wed/Fri intelligence brief with scores, buyer-intent signals, and recommended actions.

name: Morning Brief
description: Daily briefing with schedule, priorities, and what needs attention.
invoke: Say "run my morning brief" (or /morning) in Claude

name: Inbox Triage
description: Sorts recent email into reply / action / FYI / noise and drafts replies in Jim's voice for approval.

name: Capture & Route
description: Turns brain dumps into tasks, notes, people updates, and ideas, filed into Notion Assistant HQ.
invoke: Say "capture this" in Claude and dump your notes

name: Meeting Prep
description: One-page prep sheet before meetings (people, context, talking points); debrief mode logs notes and drafts follow-ups after.
invoke: Say "prep me for my next meeting" or "debrief" in Claude

name: Voice Writer
description: Drafts emails and messages in Jim's voice using his Notion voice profile and people notes.
invoke: Say "write as me" or "draft an email to..." in Claude

name: Focus Insite Tech Stack
description: Context brain: teaches Claude the company, brands, and every tool in the stack so other agents give stack-aware answers.
invoke: Works automatically behind the scenes in Claude
